% Pictures with no .xbb file in a document with TikZ and hyperref, whose
% pictures dvisvgm draws: an overpic with plain, italic, and math labels,
% a LaTeX picture that holds an \includegraphics, and a TikZ node that
% holds one. Each one builds with its labels in its image. The last node's
% picture has its .xbb file, which the fix must not break.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{overpic}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\section{Drawn}
\begin{overpic}[width=0.5\textwidth]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){P}
\put(50,50){\textit{Q} $y^2$}
\end{overpic}
After overpic.

\setlength{\unitlength}{1pt}
\begin{picture}(80,60)
\put(0,0){\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}}
\put(10,10){R}
\end{picture}
After picture.

\begin{tikzpicture}
\node[inner sep=0] (p) {\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}};
\node at (p.center) {S};
\end{tikzpicture}
After node.

\begin{tikzpicture}
\node[inner sep=0] (p) {\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-picture.png}};
\node at (p.center) {T};
\end{tikzpicture}
After found.
\end{document}
